summary: The light-touch declutter landed as the audit intended. Mina's salad offer and Maya's 'we'll all get veggie pizza' line are gone, and script[12] now reads 'mina, we want you to eat pizza too. it's lunch crew, not lunch solo'. The chat has 16 lines and flows cleanly: Mina's pepperoni offer, Brooke's plain vegetarian call-out (the stated clue, still voiced by a friend per clue rule 6), Maya's 'real veggie pizza', Brooke's reassurance, Mina's '...okay' and 'thank you both' (Brooke and Maya both still spoke), then Maya's 'that's what lunch crew is for!', which picks up script[12]. Mina's debut beat now runs once instead of twice and still establishes her. The cut also removes the 'complicated' echo of level_03 that the first review flagged. Every scored constraint is still stated plainly (pizza at script[3]-[4], healthy at script[5], $ at script[6], vegetarian at script[10], [11] and [13]). Every outcome line that points back to the chat still has its setup: Maya's Slice Society line quotes 'real veggie pizza' (script[11]), and Brooke's 'mina, no' and Mina's 'i'll just have some water' fit the remaining make-do beat. No outcome mentioned the cut lines. No new problems.
